reason_for_amendment: The parent plan froze the scenario labels but did not freeze the exact retained runs, anchor levels, scale comparison, or row-level transition calculation. This amendment supplies those details before any smoke fit or result is computed.

implemented_input_identity.test_gate: 46 selected CMLE/CMLE-WLE tests passed before registration

retained_response_source.retention_rule: Select complete source rows without regenerating or modifying ObservedCategory; save the selected rows as the smoke input and record both source-row fingerprints and file SHA-256.

truth.truth_scale: All three structural truth blocks sum to zero and therefore match the unanchored CMLE expanded sum-to-zero scale. Correct hard anchors use the same absolute expanded scale.

fit_contract.same_byte_pairing: Every scenario fit for a RunId receives the same selected Person-Rater-Criterion-ObservedCategory rows in the same order.

frozen_outputs.attempt_ledger: one row per 8 runs x 4 scenarios = 32 attempts, including every failure stage
frozen_outputs.structural_recovery: one row per expanded facet/step, retaining anchor state, truth, error, and SE
frozen_outputs.person_results: one row per fit-sample Person with TrueTheta, WLE, WLE error, exact-extreme status, raw Infit/Outfit, raw either-upper flag, and affected group
frozen_outputs.scenario_summary: descriptive aggregate by condition and scenario
frozen_outputs.same_byte_transitions: anchored raw either-upper flag versus the unanchored flag for the same RunId-Person
frozen_outputs.decision: contract/integrity checks only; no performance success gate

recovery_rules.structural_error: Estimate minus frozen truth on the labelled expanded scale; anchored rows are retained rather than excluded
recovery_rules.wle_error: fit-sample WLE Estimate minus retained TrueTheta
recovery_rules.fit_flag: either raw Infit > 1.5 or raw Outfit > 1.5; no rounded value is used
recovery_rules.transition_denominator: same RunId-Person pairs with ready fit in both the anchored scenario and unanchored baseline
recovery_rules.affected_strata: reported descriptively for random-replacement conditions; clean conditions contain only clean Persons

integrity_gates: source selection has exactly 8 complete RunIds and 24000 rows
source row fingerprint is unchanged after selection/save/reload
every returned fit preserves its supplied anchors exactly with SE zero
all returned fits use the expected free-parameter count
all scenario comparisons have identical input fingerprints within RunId
raw fit flags recompute exactly from retained Infit and Outfit
no rounded statistic is used for a decision

interpretation.allowed: debugging evidence about implementation return, rank, recovery direction, contamination transmission, sparsity, and same-byte raw fit transitions
